title: Data Usage Pattern since Start of COVID-19 and Adequacy of Digital Infrastructure
what_it_is: Data Usage Pattern since Start of COVID-19 and Adequacy of Digital Infrastructure

sections.label: Data usage and digital infrastructure
sections.summary: MCI and IMDA are working with telecom operators to enhance telecom infrastructure, including network buffers and early 5G investment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information (a) how have national data usage volume and pattern changed since the onset of COVID-19; (b) whether our digital infrastructure is currently adequate; (c) whether there are new plans to enhance our digital infrastructure post-COVID-19; and (d) how will the potential resultant increase in carbon emissions be mitigated.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: This is despite the fact that since the onset of COVID-19, our telecom operators have seen an increase in data usage volume due to telecommuting and home-based learning – as updated to this House by Minister S Iswaran last month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Singapore's digital infrastructure remains adequate for our needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Given the growing reliance on telecom services, we are also looking into measures to strengthen the security and resilience of our networks, and minimise the risk of outages.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Therefore, MCI and IMDA are working with our telecom operators to enhance our telecom infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: This includes further increasing network buffers to keep pace with future demands and investing early in 5G networks.

sections.label: IMDA investigating network outages
sections.summary: IMDA is investigating outages by StarHub, M1 and MyRepublic and will take enforcement action where operators are found liable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: IMDA takes a very serious view of such network disruptions and is investigating the causes of the outages by StarHub, M1 and MyRepublic.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Where necessary, IMDA will take enforcement action against any operator found liable for causing an outage or failing to restore services quickly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: These will be essential to the overall resilience of our digital infrastructure, and quality of service rendered to customers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: We aim to enhance our digital infrastructure in a sustainable manner that takes into consideration the energy and carbon footprint generated.
